violations.issue: Missing fallback to hardened plain Docker when gVisor unavailable. AC #8 requires: 'Fallback to hardened plain Docker works if gVisor unavailable.' No try/except exists around runtime='runsc' — container creation will fail with no fallback path.

No integration test for real Docker + egress proxy. Issue calls for 'Sandbox can reach PyPI' and 'Sandbox cannot reach arbitrary internet' — these require a real container. Unit tests mock docker-py entirely, so blocked-egress-logged-to-stdout behavior is never exercised against a live proxy.

Tests mock `docker.DockerClient` (an internal collaborator) instead of injecting a sandbox interface. Tests will break on refactor. Per mocking.md: 'Don't mock your own classes/modules' and 'Don't mock internal collaborators'. The DockerSandbox should accept an optional client so tests inject a real mock or test double at the boundary.

violations.principle: Filter injection of env vars unclear
violations.issue: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY env vars hardcoded in create(). If egress-proxy host changes, proxy URLs must be changed in code. Should be configurable via SandboxConfig or a separate network config.
